description: This file defines a service class 'CollateralManagementRepositoryWrapper' in the 'org.apache.fineract.portfolio.collateralmanagement.domain' package. It acts as a wrapper around the 'CollateralManagementDomainRepository' to perform create, read, update, and delete (CRUD) operations on collateral management domain objects within the Fineract project.

classes.name: CollateralManagementRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A Spring @Service class that encapsulates CRUD operations for collateral management domain objects, wrapping the underlying repository.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and persists a new CollateralManagementDomain object.

methods.name: getCollateral
methods.description: Retrieves a CollateralManagementDomain by its ID, throws CollateralNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getAllCollaterals
methods.description: Returns a list of all CollateralManagementDomain objects.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates and persists an existing CollateralManagementDomain object.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a CollateralManagementDomain object by its ID.
